Re: Claim C-1285 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
This letter is written on behalf of our client, Matthew Gregory, regarding injuries
sustained in a collision that occurred on 11-23-23. Our client was traveling at a low
rate of speed when the other vehicle crossed into the client's lane and struck it
head-on. The impact was significant enough to force the client's knee against the
interior of the vehicle, resulting in a painful injury that has required ongoing
medical evaluation and treatment.
Our client has since been advised by treating providers that the knee injury will
require a course of physical therapy, and that future care may be necessary depending
on the response to treatment. Our client has also missed time from work while
recovering, and has experienced persistent pain and limited mobility that affect daily
activities.
Liability in this matter appears clear. The other driver's failure to remain in their
lane directly caused the collision, and no fault can fairly be assigned to our client.
We have enclosed the available medical records, billing statements, and the police
report for your review.
On behalf of our client, we demand payment of $226,000.00 to resolve all claims arising
from this incident. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this
letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will
proceed with fliing a lawsuit without further notice.
Expert review: Curtis James, biomechanical engineer
Sincerely,
Joseph Miller
Paul & Kline Injury Lawyers
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
